name: 셀린

sources.title: 님블뉴런 공식 실험체 스킬: 자력 융합

visual_review: 푸른 단발·황금 눈·주황 작업복과 기폭장치 정체성을 유지했습니다. 코어 투척·자력 회수·폭탄 융합·기폭 대비·회수가 서로 다른 손/몸 자세로 나타납니다.
motion_summary: Celine pale blue short bob, yellow-gold eyes, orange explosives-specialist jumpsuit and small black trigger remote from identity. Official R places a magnetic fusion bomb and draws nearby plasma/empty bombs into it to become larger, then detonates. Animate idle; holding remote up; free hand throws one compact orange-gray core to right at boot level; leaning forward points at core; three tiny plasma bombs appear nearby within same cell; arm pulls back as bombs slide toward core along cyan magnet lines; fused bomb grows in place; trigger-thumb presses with body brace; orange-white contained blast right of her while she crouches shielding with sleeve; smoke fades; remote returns; original idle. No giant robot/cannon, bombs must be mechanical distinct objects not magical orbs. Actual throwing/pulling/bracing motion, face visible.
